stories.title: Mambilla: IMPI seeks review of $500,000 transaction
stories.title_en: IMPI seeks review of US$500,000 transaction
stories.summary:
Group urges authorities to examine financial records cited in ICC arbitration By Joseph Erunke, Abuja ABUJA — The Independent Media and Policy Initiative, IMPI, has called for further examination of a $500,000 transaction referenced in the International Chamber of Commerce, ICC, arbitration proceedings over the long-running dispute surrounding Nigeria’s Mambilla Hydroelectric Power Project. In a […] 
 The post  Mambilla: IMPI seeks review of $500,000 transaction  appeared first on  Vanguard News .
stories.story: The Independent Media and Policy Initiative, IMPI, has called for further examination of a US$500,000 transaction referenced in the International Chamber of Commerce, ICC.

stories.title: Game Publishers Eye Doc Request In Valve Antitrust Case
stories.title_en: Game Publishers Eye Doc request in Valve antitrust case
stories.summary: Video-game publishers accusing Valve Corp. in a federal antitrust lawsuit of manipulating arbitration pacts with gaming customers have questioned the gamers' bid for access to the publishers' purportedly protected materials as the gamers fight a separate case against the digital content company.

stories.title: KS Invest v. Spain — the ad hoc Committee holds a hearing on annulment in person in Paris
stories.summary: KS Invest brought the claim against Spain under the ECT (Energy Charter Treaty), in the electric power and other energy sector; it was registered on 28 July 2025. King & Spalding acts for the claimant. State Attorney´s Office and Ministry of the Presidency, Justice and Relations with Parliament for Spain. The tribunal is Michele Potestà, presiding; Tina M. Cicchetti; Tatyana Slipachuk. On 23 September 2026, the ad hoc Committee holds a hearing on annulment in person in Paris.
claimants: KS Invest GmbH and TLS Invest GmbH
counsel: King & Spalding, Paris, France and Houston, TX, U.S.A.
Ministry of the Presidency, Justice and Relations with Parliament, Madrid, Spain

enforcement.title: US judge backs Iraq as net creditor in oil dispute with Turkey
enforcement.summary: A US magistrate judge has recommended that a district court grant Iraq’s petition to confirm an ICC award issued in a multibillion-dollar dispute with Turkey over crude oil exports, rejecting Turkey’s arguments that it should be considered the net award creditor.

corroboration.title: Iraq's $1.5B Arbitration Win Should Be Upheld, DC Judge Says
corroboration.snippet: A D.C. federal magistrate judge has recommended granting Iraq's Ministry of Oil's petition seeking to enforce a $1.47 billion arbitral award it won against Turkey after the country violated a pipeline agreement, but the magistrate judge held off on endorsing a specific number Turkey must pay to Iraq.

corroboration.title: Turkey seized 1,326 companies, $32 billion in assets in Gülen crackdown: report
corroboration.snippet: Turkey’s Savings Deposit Insurance Fund (TMSF) has announced auctions for insurance agency Sürat Sigorta and paper company Kaynak Kağıt in October, continuing the sale of businesses seized during the government’s crackdown on the faith-based Gülen movement. The sale notices were published in Tuesday’s Official Gazette, the Ekonomi newspaper reported.

corroboration.title: Turkey's Central Bank Revokes Operating License of Papel Elektronik Para
corroboration.snippet: Turkey’s central bank has revoked the operating license of electronic money and payment services company Papel, which has been at the center of an investigation into allegations that proceeds from illegal betting, fraud and other crimes were laundered through its payment infrastructure, the T24 news website reported.
